structured_output.what_is_happening: "The Agents" ($Agents) is a 12-minute-old pump.fun coin that is still on its bonding curve. It pitches a Solana launchpad where token creators deploy rule-based on-chain "agents": Sentinel pays holder rewards, Phoenix runs buybacks and burns, Fortuna runs prize draws. The project site theagents.fun shows this exact contract, so this is the canonical token. In 12 minutes it went from launch to about $29k mcap (+500-700%), with about $46k volume and 298 unique buyers. The curve holds 88 of the ~115 virtual SOL needed to migrate. GMGN tags 109 bundler wallets among 125 holders, puts dev/team holdings at 12.7%, and says the dev's X account has launched 4 tokens before. Several copycat "The Agents" tokens have already been deployed.

narrative.description: A utility-style launchpad in the AI-agents-on-pump.fun theme: autonomous agents running rewards, buyback/burn and lottery for tokens. The theme is current (pump.fun agent skills, Mayhem Mode) but crowded with look-alike launchpads (spawn, funkos, pumpgents, clawpump).
narrative.why_spreading: There is a launch-day pump with a professional-looking site and docs. I found no organic X, Reddit or news discussion. Early flow looks driven by bundles and bots, not by any spreading social conversation.

token_connection.why_this_token: theagents.fun lists this exact contract (26JCsJ...pump), and the packet links @agents_pf to this token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several same-name clones: DSd2...BAGS, 26JBQ...pump (vanity look-alike with $41k h1 volume, now $3.4k mcap), GG4h..., Euua..., MXsG.... None has liquidity or traction. Two of them (Euua..., GG4h...) were created before this token and may be the dev's own earlier launch attempts.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 109 of 125 holders as bundlers; top bundler trader share is 44.5% and bot/degen rate is 53%. Dev/team hold 12.7%. The dev's X account has launched 4 tokens and the creator's best ATH is only $36.6k. There are no paid DexScreener boosts, but the DexScreener profile was updated. Searches found no organic X posts.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is poorly indexed and private Telegram groups are invisible. The 298 unique buyers is a decent count, but it may be inflated by bundles.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler presence (109 wallets, 44.5% top bundler share) that can dump into the curve
Dev X account has 4 prior launches, none above ~$37k ATH
m5 sells outnumber buys; the price is already down from ATH 3.66e-5
Migration at ~115 virtual SOL could be a sell-the-news event

structured_output.counterargument: This is the canonical token with a real-looking product site, docs and a live theme (agents on pump.fun). It has close to 300 unique buyers in 12 minutes and is about 27 SOL from migrating. Migration often brings a fresh wave of attention, and a 2x only needs about $58k mcap, which is a small absolute move.
unknowns: Whether @agents_pf has real followers or engagement
Whether the 4 prior launches from the dev's X account rugged
Whether the bundles belong to the dev team
Whether the launchpad product actually works

source_coverage.notes: The site confirms the CA. The contract search returned nothing. The X site: search returned only unrelated agents.fun and Olas accounts.

structured_output.thesis: A canonical, utility-themed pump.fun launch that is close to migrating, with decent early buyer count, but dominated by bundlers and launched by a dev X account with several earlier low-ceiling launches. It could make a 2x run toward and through migration, but bundle dumping is the likelier outcome. Slightly above the pool average.
